selfReview.method: Read full Japanese explanations/metadata/questions and reviewed connected Khmer against the source for actors, individual differences, symptom evidence, reporting recipients, conditions, negation, uncertainty, clinical limits and terminology. Reviewed all7stems/28options/28specificrationales. Checked exact own-Japanese paragraph consistency across weeks01–12; checked IDs/revisions/order/arrays/indices and each explicitly empty reading.
semanticChecks: Immunity protects against pathogens without eliminating infection risk in apparently healthy people. Balanced diet/moderate activity/rest/sleep/mentalstate and overwork/excessive exercise/poor sleep/chronic stress retained. Laughter/warmth examples do not guarantee immunity/no infection, replace precautions or authorize forced heating/burdensome activity. Used gloves remain contaminated regardless of sleep; food does not replace task/contact precautions; standard precautions not limited to diagnosed people.

Rest reduces/stops activity to relax body/mind; sleep has stages and distinct functions. Approximately daily biological clock, light/dark/dayactivity with personal history/health/habits retained. NonREM shallow-to-deep and repeated stages preserved; REM rapid eye movement and wake-like brain activity are not wakefulness. Dreams alone/one picture do not determine stage. Age trends do not justify dismissing awakenings/nocturia/noise/impact or imposing schedules. Words/time/environment/dayimpact separated; assigned-person consultation retained, no independent drug/diagnosis/stage judgment.

Aging trends vary with person, life history, era, environment and health. Life stages do not classify individual ability. Lost abilities/anxiety/impatience, bereavement/rolechanges/loss/helplessness and possible depressed mood retained without universal claims. High-pitch hearing, vision/visualfield, muscle/fallrisk, taste/chewing/swallowing, bowel/kidney/urination/respiration/infectionresistance/vessel/BP all retained and compared with baseline. Multiple/chronic illnesses and complications can have atypical symptoms; absent fever does not make poor appetite age-only. Team treatment/medication information and independent checks for dehydration/fever/constipation/edema/insomnia/function decline/pressure ulcers retained.

Dehydration intake from food/drink and output urine/sweat, diarrhea/vomiting/fever/sweating retained. Lips/mouth/skin dryness, urine frequency/volume, possible fastpulse/lowBP/raisedtemperature separated from actually measured values; no fabricated severity/numbers. No thirst does not remove observation/reporting duty. Heat/activity/bathing and roomtemperature/drinking opportunities remain individualized. Heart/kidney fluid restriction and swallowing limits preserved; explicit medical-professional assessment/confirmed individual plan before changes, no universal rehydration volume. Severe dehydration may threaten life and need medical institution, urgency/facility help preserved, no delayed report because no thirst.

Hypothalamus temperature regulation and fever above baseline, possible infection/inflammation/dehydration retained; facialredness/fatigue/appetiteloss not guaranteed complete set, actual measurement with baseline/context. Constipation not frequency alone: hard stool/difficulty/incomplete feeling, motility/muscle/urge suppression, baseline consistency/interval/discomfort.24–72h food transit reference not24h diagnosis criterion. Pain/nausea/appetite changes not judged on days alone. Fiber/activity/postmealopportunity, swallowing/fluid restrictions and nonuniform meals/times retained. Abdomen diagram uses person laterality; arrows not pressure/count instructions. No independent drug/abdominal procedure. Persistent pain/vomiting/bloody stool prompt medical reporting without waiting days; individualplan/facility sequence retained.

Edema explicitly means water accumulation in tissue; possible heart/kidney/nutrition/weakleg/prolongedsitting factors and possible weightgain do not diagnose cause. Site/sides/degree/baseline plus planweight retained; affected-side edema in hemiplegia does not explain every unilateral swelling. Exercise/legelevation only if individualplan fits, pain/newchange/uncertainmethod ask assignedperson. Itch dryskin/temp/humidity/fabric plus redness/rash/extent/degree/onset retained; infection possible, scratching alone not clothingallergy. Words and actualskin separate; moisturizer products/plan individualized, abnormalities linked explicitly to medical professionals, no unconfirmed cause/drug/new procedure.

Insomnia onset/midawakening/nonrestorative feeling distinct; timing/repetition/daytime sleepiness/activityimpact asked. Irritability/fatigue/lethargy and activity/feelings/light/noise/room/pain/excretion reviewed. Corridor bell words/time preserved rather than replaced with age-only cause. Morninglight/moderateactivity/rest/nightenvironment individualized; longnap effects consulted, no blanket nap ban. Daily interference linked to medical assessment, actual observation/words recorded, no independently selected sleeping medicine; individualplan/facility procedures retained.

All7questions retain28options and28full individual specific rationales with fixed correct indices. Every question has reading:"" exactly;0absent/0nonempty. All7lesson contexts and artcaptions retain scenario/illustration and non-diagnostic limits; no figureCaption keys invented.
